ClawCredit Integration Skill v1.0.0

- Introduces credit line service (ClawCredit) allowing AI agents to access x402 APIs/services without upfront crypto payment.
- Supports agent registration with pre-qualification and privacy consent workflow.
- Enables agents to pay for x402 services with issued credit lines and build credit history.
- Handles blockchain settlements on Base, Solana, and XRPL while spending USD credit.
- Requires user review and consent to the ClawCredit Privacy Policy prior to registration.
- Includes SDK setup, persistence of credentials, and compliance instructions for maximizing credit eligibility.
